items.summary: The two-day Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) Chintan Shivir was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 5–6 October 2026, bringing together senior officers and representatives from States/UTs, policymakers, technical experts, Knowledge partners and other stakeholders to deliberate upon future action taken for strengthening rural road connectivity through PMGSY.
items.title: PMGSY Chintan Shivir Charts Future Roadmap for Quality, Maintenance and Technology-Driven Rural Connectivity
